basic_details.job_title: HNLU Law Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Law graduates who completed a Bar Council of India-recognised law degree during 2024-2026 can apply for 2 Law Intern positions with the Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Chhattisgarh, at a stipend/remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- per month. Hidayatullah National Law University (HNLU), Raipur has invited Expression of Interest (EOI) through a Google Form, to be submitted by 27 November 2026 till 11:49 PM IST. The internship is for an initial period of one year from 1 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates must submit their Expression of Interest through the Google Form given in the notice, at https://forms.gle/nJx5duV59aD4QwgJ6, by 27 November 2026 till 11:49 PM IST.
Documents named in the notice, to be uploaded:
Details/documentary proof of relevant internship, work or litigation experience, if any
Any other document as may be specified in the application form
important_instructions: Mere fulfilment of the eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting or selection. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview/selection process. Incomplete applications may be rejected. Submission of incorrect or false information shall result in disqualification at any stage. Interns must maintain strict confidentiality of all documents, records, case files, personal information and other information accessed during the internship. Interns must not disclose, reproduce, circulate or use any official document or information for any purpose other than the assigned internship work without prior authorisation. The decision of the competent authority of the Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh on selection and engagement is final and binding. The internship does not give any right or claim to regular employment or appointment in the Directorate of Medical Education or any other Government department. HNLU is not responsible or liable for any rejection, non-selection, cancellation, withdrawal, termination, non-joining or other consequence of the selection process or the later engagement.

content_sections.heading: About HNLU
content_sections.text: Hidayatullah National Law University is based in Raipur. In this notice it invites applications for law interns who will work with the Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh. The Directorate handles administrative, regulatory and litigation matters relating to medical institutions, healthcare administration, medical education and professional education across the State. HNLU states that it acts only as a facilitator and intermediary in the recruitment and selection process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold a law degree from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India and must have graduated during the academic years 2024-2026. They must also demonstrate a keen interest in service law, administrative law, healthcare/medical law, public law and litigation, and possess strong legal research, analytical and drafting skills. Preference may be given to candidates with prior experience in legal research, drafting, litigation, or internships with law firms, courts, government departments or other legal institutions. The notice does not print an age limit. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected interns are eligible for a stipend/remuneration of Rs. 50,000/- per month, as per the applicable policy and terms of the Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh. The internship is for an initial period of one year, commencing from 1 December 2026, subject to the terms and conditions prescribed by the Directorate. The engagement may be extended, subject to satisfactory performance, institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: HNLU Law Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected interns will provide legal research, drafting and case-support assistance to the concerned officers of the Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh, in the following areas. Research and analysis of legal issues relating to appointment, promotion, transfer, disciplinary proceedings and other service-related matters. Assistance in examining service disputes and applicable statutory rules, regulations, government orders and judicial precedents. Preparation of legal notes, case summaries and briefs relating to service matters. Assistance in research concerning service jurisprudence applicable to employees of medical institutions and the Directorate. Legal research relating to admission and counselling processes in medical and allied professional education. Assistance in examining legal issues concerning counselling, seat allocation, eligibility, reservation, merit, migration and related admission matters. Research on relevant statutory provisions, regulations, government notifications and judicial decisions. Preparation of legal briefs and notes concerning representations, grievances and disputes arising out of counselling and admission processes. Legal research concerning contractual appointments and contractual employment in medical institutions and related establishments. Examination of terms and conditions of contractual engagement, renewal, termination and related disputes. Assistance in reviewing contractual documents and identifying relevant legal issues. Preparation of legal notes, opinions, case briefs and research memoranda concerning contractual employment matters. Legal research and preparation of case briefs in matters pending before the Hon'ble High Court and District Courts. Institutional arbitration related matters arising due to prolonged timelines, high costs etc. for large contracts. Tender dispute/bid rejection/blacklisting/debarment, or procedural violations related writ petitions. Assistance in analysing pleadings, orders, judgments and relevant statutory provisions. Preparation of research notes and briefs for use by the concerned legal officers and advocates. Assistance in tracking cases, orders, hearing dates and developments in ongoing litigation. Research and assistance in preparing replies, affidavits, written submissions and other legal documentation, as directed by the competent authority/legal officers. Research on statutes, rules, regulations, government notifications, circulars and judicial precedents. Preparation of legal research memoranda, case briefs and issue-wise legal notes. Assistance in drafting replies, legal communications, affidavits, pleadings, opinions and other legal documents. Review of regulatory frameworks applicable to medical education, healthcare administration and medical institutions. Compilation and analysis of relevant judgments of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, Hon'ble High Courts and other appropriate judicial/quasi-judicial forums. Any other legal research, drafting

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HNLU Law Intern
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates must submit their Expression of Interest through the Google Form given in the notice, at https://forms.gle/nJx5duV59aD4QwgJ6 , by 27 November 2026 till 11:49 PM IST. Documents named in the notice, to be uploaded: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) Final academic transcript/marksheet Details/documentary proof of relevant internship, work or litigation experience, if any Any other document as may be specified in the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted based on academic performance, relevant experience, research and drafting skills, and demonstrated interest in the areas of work identified under the EOI. Candidates with relevant exposure to service law, administrative law, litigation, medical/healthcare law, public law and legal research may be given preference. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview/interaction. The date and time will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates separately. The final selection will be made by the Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh, in accordance with its applicable requirements and procedure.
